name: Rebekah
overview: Rebekah, also called Rebecca, is introduced in Scripture as the daughter of Bethuel, who was the son of Milcah and Nahor, Abraham's brother, establishing her close kinship to Abraham's family (Genesis 22:20-23). She is described as a beautiful virgin who came to the well to draw water, an event that marks the beginning of her role as Isaac's wife (Genesis 24:15-16). These passages highlight God's providential guidance in bringing Rebekah into the covenant community, underscoring her significance in the unfolding of God's promises to Abraham's descendants.
